newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spain's debt market recovered from its initial losses to end little changed on Tuesday, bolstered by news over a draft deal to reform the labour market, dealers said.
"The market's mood is positive. Peripheral markets are now in a good shape, and Spain outperforms Italy where politics weigh," a dealer in Madrid said.
On Wednesday, dealers expect yields to fall for the first time since mid-February at the six-month Treasury bill auction.
Dealers were also eyeing March CPI which is expected to fall to below 2.4 percent year-on-year from 2.5 percent in February.
March CPI will be released on Friday.
The 10-year spread over Bunds fell below 100 basis points today for its first time since February 3, when it rose back above that level. It hit a record low at 83 basis points on January 22.
In the meantime, the 10-year spread below Italian's BTPS increased to around 85 basis points from 81 bps this morning.
